data.narrative:
Freenome, a publicly traded biotech and health company founded by Gabriel Otte, has raised over $1.3B and carries a current valuation of $1.1B. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 peers—3 public-market equities and 8 private venture-backed companies spanning the same sector and valuation tier, including Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Alto Neuroscience, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. A cohort of 5 same-sector, similar-valuation peers yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples cannot be applied given the absence of disclosed revenue figures for the target. The sector median P/S across 3 public biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) stands at 6.2x but remains inapplicable without revenue data.

The triangulated valuation range derived from peer-median analysis is $1.4B to $1.8B, with a central estimate of $1.6B. This implies the current $1.1B valuation sits modestly below the peer median, though still within a plausible range given the wide dispersion across comparable companies. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue metrics for multiple comparables and the heterogeneity of development stages within the peer set, which spans Series B through public markets.
